metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp amplifier and a 64-channel cap (online reference FCz, ground AFz, plus an infraorbital EOG electrode) at 1,000 Hz with impedances below 20 kΩ. Twenty newspaper articles were presented word by word via RSVP in PsychoPy (500 ms per word, 500 ms blank). Preprocessing used MNE-Python and Eelbrain: ICA-based ocular artifact removal, 0.1-40 Hz bandpass filtering, common average re-referencing, epoching from -100 to 1000 ms, downsampling to 200 Hz, and baseline correction.
